manifest.objective: Define the compact operating contract hydrated by one resolver for an (actor, mode, workflow) selection, without granting permission. The model is project-agnostic; GitHub, git, issues, and PRs are adapters or source examples only. Artifacts are draftable, creatable, traceable, or documentable units with one responsibility and, when template-backed, one required_template .md file. Skills are optional capabilities requested by the PM or recommended by a route prompt; they never authorize or replace gates. This surface operates only from project-os-en/kernel/*.json as the explicitly selected English peer of the default Spanish surface; removed historical surfaces are never routes.
resolution_sequence: Treat it as mandatory operating guidance.
Follow the limits and the context of the acting surface.
Follow the allowed and prohibited actions of the resolved execution mode.
Follow the workflow evidence, outputs, and artifacts.
Treat any requested optional skill as a capability reference, never as permission or workflow logic.
